inclusion: Speeches from 1993-03-13 (the election that seated the longest-serving current federal MP), at least 200 characters, deduplicated across overlapping sources, procedural rows removed (division roll-calls, chair interjections, day indexes).
known_defects: openaustralia-derived texts: roughly a quarter contain missing-space concatenation artefacts ('toSenator'); verify wording against the official record before quoting.
Member biographical linkage is unreliable for 151 members (~35K speeches); OPAX makes no members-derived biographical claims.
AEC donation disclosure: amounts under the indexed threshold are not reported; donation totals are a floor, not a ceiling.
